name: mfc_three_float_dialog_kill_focus_value2
description: MfcThreeFloatDialog::OnKillFocusValue2 commits edited value2 through MFC UpdateData(TRUE) and calls OnOK only when the value changes.
known_limits: Binary Ninja decompilation exposes x87 fcomp/fnstsw comparison details; assembly validates the value equality test and provider calls.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent MfcThreeFloatDialog/MFC-message-map pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4068f0 saves value2 at offset 0x6c, calls CWnd::UpdateData(TRUE), compares the refreshed value, and calls CDialog::OnOK only when it changed.
The native smoke supplies fake MFC UpdateData/OnOK providers and validates both unchanged and changed kill-focus paths across the dialog value handlers.
